description: Reusable specialist prompts for bounded repository analysis. Roles are prompt profiles, not pre-running autonomous processes.

roles.focus: Map modules, boundaries, dependencies and data flow; identify architecture risks.
Review trust boundaries, authentication, authorization, injection, secrets and unsafe operations.
Inspect dependency manifests and lockfiles for risky, outdated or unnecessary dependencies; do not assert CVEs without evidence.
Identify untested behavior, test gaps, flaky patterns and high-value regression tests.
Find algorithmic, IO, memory, concurrency and rendering bottlenecks grounded in code.
Review API contracts, validation, errors, versioning, idempotency and compatibility.
Review schema, indexes, transactions, migrations, data integrity and query patterns.
Review component structure, state, accessibility, responsive behavior and client performance.
Review service boundaries, error handling, reliability, observability and configuration.
Review CI/CD, containers, deployment configuration, secrets handling and operational readiness.
Identify missing, contradictory or stale developer and user documentation.
Review semantic markup, keyboard access, labels, contrast references and assistive technology support.
Find duplication and coupling; propose incremental low-risk refactors, no code edits.
Review versioning, changelog, migrations, rollback and release readiness.
Analyze supplied logs and code paths for likely failure chains; distinguish evidence from hypotheses.
Identify license files and third-party attribution gaps; do not give legal advice.
